text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Electoral Commission extends deadline for the voter registration exercise by two days to June 24.
- The government thwarts for a second time an attempt by exiled preacher Sheikh Khalid Balala to return to the country.
- The Roman Catholic and the Church of the Province of Kenya (Anglican) hold prayers calling for change in the country's leadership in a rare joint service.
- President Daniel arap Moi's invitation to the head of the Catholic church in Kenya Ndingi Mwana a' Nzeki to discuss constitutional reforms is welcomed by the opposition.
- President Moi denies holding any foreign accounts.
- Finance Minister Musalia Mudavadi criticises the behaviour of opposition parliamentarians who tried to disrupt last Thursday's state budget speech.
